_comment: Configure the 4-step welcome message drip sequence sent when a prospect accepts a friend request.
_variables_guide: You can use {name} (prospect display name), {username} (prospect handle), {server} (origin server), {sender} (sender account name).

messages.message: Hey {name}! Thanks for connecting 👋 Saw you joined {server}.
How long have you been trading or investing in the markets?
Check this out — this was one of our top setups from today's session.
Let me know if you want me to share the breakdown or if you have any questions!
